<include name="ContainerShowInfoOnclick">
        <!-- Excludes items whose path is one of XStream Player's own direct
             single-stream play URLs (Continue Watching's tiles, always this
             shape): those are an explicit "resume/play this exact thing"
             choice already made, not a show to browse into, so they should
             just play on click instead of stopping at an info screen first. -->
        <onclick condition="[String.IsEqual(Container($PARAM[widgetid]).ListItem.DBType,movie) | String.IsEqual(Container($PARAM[widgetid]).ListItem.DBType,tvshow) | String.IsEqual(Container($PARAM[widgetid]).ListItem.DBType,episode) | !String.IsEmpty(Container($PARAM[widgetid]).ListItem.AddonName)] + !String.Contains(Container($PARAM[widgetid]).ListItem.Path,mode=play_stream)">Action(info)</onclick>
    </include>
